Thermal-Reflective Warmth

Finished Features

Binding at hood and cuffs to seal out the elements and create a finished look.

Hidden Storage

Versatile Closure

Built To Move

An Active Fit is closer to the body to allow freedom of movement on any adventure.

Thermal-Reflective Warmth

Omni-Heat™ thermal-reflective breathable lining retains warmth using silver dots that reflect body heat, so you stay warm and comfortable as temps drop.

Waterproof-Breathable Protection

Omni-Tech™ sheds water and releases excess heat with multi-layered breathable materials, so you stay dry and comfortable in the rain.



Light Warmth

Climate: Best for crisp cool fall and spring days.

When to wear it: Made for cool days outside on short trips from trail to street, light jackets and fleece can serve as an extra layer of cozy warmth.




Medium Warmth

Climate: Best for blustery, brisk winter weather.

When to wear it: Made for cold weather with light insulation and/or breathable thermal-reflective lining to help keep chills at bay while being active outdoors.




Maximum Warmth

Climate: Best for snow, ice, and bitter windchill.

When to wear it: Made for frigid weather with combinations of warming technologies that pack a punch, like high-efficiency insulation and technology.

Thermal-Reflective Warmth

Revolutionary silver dots reflect and retain body heat for enhanced lightweight warmth.

Water And Stain Repellent

A long-lasting, quick-drying technology that repels water and stains by preventing liquids from absorbing into the yarns and saturating or staining your apparel.

Lightweight Synthetic Insulation

Combines the look and feel of down with the resilience of synthetic insulation to deliver more warmth and less weight.

Everything You Need

  • Omni-Heat™ thermal-reflective breathable lining retains warmth using silver dots that reflect body heat, so you stay warm and comfortable as temps drop
  • Omni-Shield™ repels moisture and resists stains by preventing liquids from absorbing into fast-drying yarns, so you stay clean and dry in damp, messy conditions
  • 100% recycled polyester Thermarator™ insulation keeps you warm with lightweight synthetic fibers that retain heat even when wet, so you stay comfortable on cold, damp days

  • Zippered hand pockets and interior security pocket for small items
  • Binding on hood and cuffs for a finished look
